comparison.objective: Withdraw an index latch, swing a footrest, and re-engage it in a second slot, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Latch retraction, articulated swinging, and pin-slot engagement overlap generically with manipulation of retained mechanisms, but not rotary calibration or dynamic observation.
comparison.success_condition: Footrest cleared, both handles released, and pin engaged in second slot; engagement depth and transfer-space tolerances are not stated.
comparison.reason: Tests discrete latch-indexed reconfiguration, whereas the candidate tests continuous damping adjustment and lock retention.
